source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 2 summary (PDF 64).

blocks.text: Is chapter ne Python ki zaroori baatein batayin, development environment tayyar karne se advanced tareeqon tak: bunyadi syntax, operators aur control structures; functions, modules aur data structures; modular aur object-oriented programming; aur exception handling, file ke amal aur debugging. In maharaton se aap zyada pecheeda kaam aur mazboot Python CLI applications bana sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Chapter 2 ek nazar mein
rows: variables, int/float/str/bool, input() aur print(), comments
if, if-else, short hand, if-elif-else, nesting; while, for, range()
def, return, default, keyword aur arbitrary arguments
import, standard library, packages, main function, CLI
classes, objects, access modifiers, constructor, association, inheritance, polymorphism
try/except/else/finally, custom exceptions, files, unittest, debugging

items: Setup se OOP, files aur debugging tak Python; CLI applications ke liye tayyar.
